name: HYDRA-UMC-SEMANTIC-PLANNER
notes: Real v0 rule-based task decomposition (`decompose` subcommand, small known goal vocabulary) and real rule-based semantic recovery over structured MCU error codes (`recover` subcommand). Real precondition validation (validation.py) refuses a plan that fails its own preconditions instead of handing it off as execution-ready; decompose_goal() is proven deterministic and fuzz-tested against 500 random invalid goals. Honestly template-based, not the local LLM the README describes - that and context-aware multi-step reasoning are future work.
